title: Dental and Vision Savings Memberships Fee Schedule
content:
# Dental and Vision Savings Memberships — Fee Schedule

All fees of the Dental and Vision Savings Memberships are stated in US dollars. The annual membership fee is the fee per year when the membership is billed annually; the monthly membership fee is the fee per month when it is billed monthly; the activation fee is a one-time fee on monthly billing. Where the activation fee is shown as waived on annual billing, no activation fee is charged on annual billing.

## Fees by membership

| Membership | Annual membership fee | Monthly membership fee | Activation fee (monthly billing, once) | Activation fee waived on annual billing |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade Smile Savings Individual | 99.95 | 11.95 | 15.00 | Yes |
| Cascade Smile Savings Household | 149.95 | 17.95 | 15.00 | Yes |
| Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Individual | 119.95 | 13.95 | 15.00 | Yes |
| Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Household | 179.95 | 20.95 | 15.00 | Yes |
| Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Plus Individual | 159.95 | 17.95 | 15.00 | Yes |
| Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Plus Household | 229.95 | 25.95 | 15.00 | Yes |

## Billing frequencies and rounding

| Membership | Billing frequencies offered | Rounding of amounts |
|---|---|---|
| All six memberships listed above | Annual; monthly | Rounded half up to the cent |

Every membership is offered on both annual and monthly billing. Amounts are rounded half up to the cent: a value whose third decimal place is 5 or more rounds up to the next cent, and one whose third decimal place is below 5 rounds down.

## Reading the schedule

- **Annual billing, any membership:** the annual membership fee shown for that membership, with no activation fee, because the activation fee is waived on annual billing for all six memberships.
- **Monthly billing, any membership:** the monthly membership fee shown for that membership, together with the one-time activation fee of 15.00.
- **Same monthly fee, different memberships:** Cascade Smile Savings Household and Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Plus Individual both show a monthly membership fee of 17.95; their annual membership fees differ (149.95 and 159.95).
